title: Canonical video self-supervised learning paper audit
source_policy: Discover by exact-title scholarly search, then confirm using official proceedings, publisher or DOI metadata, arXiv, and official project records.
dataset_policy: Keep self-supervised or backbone pretraining datasets separate from downstream evaluation datasets.

records.title: Beyond reconstruction: Enhancing masked autoencoders with contrastive learning for video representation learning
records.method_description: A dual-track heterogeneous framework that assigns contrastive learning and masked video modeling to different ViT layers and adds motion-aware progressive masking.
records.dataset_notes: Accessible implementation metadata explicitly names Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2. The publisher abstract also reports video object segmentation but does not expose the segmentation dataset name, so no dataset was guessed.
records.venue: Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, volume 171, article 114283 (2026)
records.audit_notes: The final peer-reviewed journal record is confirmed as Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence, volume 171, article 114283, published 2026-05-01. The DOI and full bibliographic record were added.

records.title: BIMM: Brain Inspired Masked Modeling for Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: Brain-inspired ventral image MAE and dorsal video masked modeling pathways share selected parameters and learn progressive multi-block targets.
records.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology 2026
records.audit_notes: The 2024 arXiv paper was promoted to the 2026 IEEE TCSVT version of record.

records.title: Depth-Wise Representation Development Under Blockwise Self-Supervised Learning for Video Vision Transformers
records.method_description: Gradient-isolated Video Vision Transformer blocks, each trained with a local VideoMAE masked-reconstruction loss, compared with end-to-end learning.
records.dataset_notes: UCF101 is used for pretraining and downstream probing. Synthetic drifting-grating clips are generated by the study and are not a named external dataset.
records.audit_notes: No official conference or journal publication was found as of the verification date; retained as a preprint. The stray trailing semicolon in the author display was removed.

records.title: Dual Perspectives on Non-Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning
records.method_description: A theoretical and empirical study links stop-gradient and exponential-moving-average teacher dynamics through complementary optimization perspectives.
records.audit_notes: Originally listed as a 2025 arXiv preprint; the official OpenReview record confirms publication at ICLR 2026.

records.title: Factorized Latent Dynamics for Video JEPA: An Empirical Study of Auxiliary Objectives
records.method_description: A Video-JEPA auxiliary objective that factorizes appearance and dynamics subspaces and applies hard-region weighting to JEPA prediction and latent-dynamics errors.
records.dataset_notes: The paper compares a UCF101-only pretraining regime with a mixed UCF101, Something-Something V2, and ImageNet-100 regime. Frozen evaluation uses Diving48, Something-Something V2, and ImageNet-100.
records.audit_notes: No official conference or journal publication was found as of the verification date; retained as a preprint.

records.title: From Static to Dynamic: Exploring Self-supervised Image-to-Video Representation Transfer Learning
records.method_description: Consistency-Separability Trade-off Transfer Learning with a frozen image encoder, lightweight projection, temporal cycle consistency, and a semantic separability constraint.
records.dataset_notes: Co-Settle is trained for five epochs on Kinetics-400. ImageNet-1K, WIT-400M, and LAION-400M are sources for the evaluated frozen image backbones. The original catalog's UCF101 and HMDB51-only annotation was incomplete.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv version is superseded as the catalog link by the official CVPR 2026 proceedings version.

records.title: OneVision-Encoder: Codec-Aligned Sparsity as a Foundational Principle for Multimodal Intelligence
records.method_description: Codec-aligned sparse patchification with shared 3D RoPE and self-supervised multi-label cluster discrimination over image and video concepts.
records.dataset_notes: The dataset list covers the full pretraining corpus and the paper's seven attentive-probing video representation benchmarks. General multimodal LMM benchmark tables are outside this VideoSSL catalog field.
records.audit_notes: No official conference or journal publication was found as of the verification date; retained as a preprint. The full arXiv author list replaces the abbreviated repository entry.

records.title: Progressive Mask Distillation for Self-supervised Video Representation
records.method_description: Progressive masked video modeling with increasing mask ratios, progressive student distillation, difficulty-aware region enhancement, and cross-layer feature alignment.
records.dataset_notes: The student and video teacher are pretrained on Kinetics-400; the image teacher is pretrained on ImageNet-1K. The four named downstream datasets are evaluated by fine-tuning.
records.audit_notes: Final venue confirmed in the official CVPR 2026 proceedings.

records.title: Recurrent Video Masked Autoencoders
records.method_description: A recurrent masked autoencoder processes long videos through repeated latent-state updates and reconstructs masked content over time.
records.audit_notes: Originally listed as a 2025 arXiv preprint; the official CVF proceedings confirm CVPR 2026.

records.title: Rethinking JEPA: Compute-Efficient Video SSL with Frozen Teachers
records.method_description: Static-teacher asymmetric latent training predicts frozen teacher representations with an efficient student and avoids a momentum-updated target encoder.
records.dataset_notes: The V-3.6M mixture combines Kinetics-710, Something-Something V2, and a 2.8M-video Panda-70M subset; ImageNet-1K is used in image ablations.
records.audit_notes: Originally listed as a 2025 arXiv preprint; the final publication is ICLR 2026.

records.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Structured Dynamics from Videos
records.method_description: Future-feature prediction over a frozen image encoder that separates dominant primary motion from residual dynamics, with weak synthetic scene-level supervision.
records.dataset_notes: ProbeMotion uses controlled Kubric and DL3DV probes, CameraBench, static-camera subsets of DAVIS 2017 and YouTube-VOS, and the SSv2-110k subset.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv record explicitly describes this version as a preprint; no official conference or journal publication was found as of the verification date.

records.title: Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning in a Heuristic Decoupled Perspective
records.method_description: Bi-level optimization and Koopman eigen-decomposition decouple static and dynamic semantics during video contrastive learning.
records.audit_notes: The 2024 arXiv record was promoted to the 2026 IJCV version of record.

records.title: Structured-Noise Masked Modeling for Video, Audio and Beyond
records.method_description: Masked modeling with optimized structured noise patterns, including Green3D masks for video and blue-noise masks for audio, to improve information coverage.
records.audit_notes: Originally listed as a 2025 arXiv preprint; the author publication record confirms ECCV 2026 oral acceptance.

records.title: The TIME Machine: On The Power of Motion for Efficient Perception
records.method_description: A masked autoencoder over sparse point trajectories that reconstructs masked motion tracks and learns entirely from synthetic rigid-body simulations.
records.dataset_notes: The main model is pretrained on 250,000 Kubric MOVi-B synthetic videos. A second-stage Something-Something V2 trajectory pretraining experiment is an ablation, not the default model.
records.audit_notes: No official conference or journal publication was found as of the verification date; retained as a preprint.

records.title: TrackMAE: Video Representation Learning via Track Mask and Predict
records.method_description: Motion-aware masked video modeling that reconstructs tracked point trajectories alongside pixel or feature targets and uses motion-aware tube masking.
records.dataset_notes: The main encoder is pretrained on Kinetics-400. SEVERE contributes eight evaluation settings drawn from Something-Something V2, FineGYM, UCF101, UCFRep, and Charades.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv version is superseded as the catalog link by the official CVPR 2026 proceedings version.

records.title: TrAction: Action Recognition with Sparse Trajectories
records.method_description: A compact 2.5D point-trajectory transformer with self-supervised masked-trajectory autoencoding before action-recognition fine-tuning.
records.dataset_notes: UCF101 and HMDB51 are discussed only as appearance-dominated examples and are not counted as evaluated datasets.
records.audit_notes: A conference-like search result had no matching official proceedings record or arXiv acceptance comment, so the venue remains preprint.

records.title: V-JEPA 2.1: Unlocking Dense Features in Video Self-Supervised Learning
records.method_description: Dense masked latent feature prediction with weighted context prediction, deep self-supervision, modality-specific tokenizers, and large-scale image-video pretraining.
records.dataset_notes: VisionMix-163M combines Something-Something V2, Kinetics, HowTo100M, YT-1B, and LVD-142M. DROID and PerceptionLM are used in downstream alignment or world-model training rather than the foundation pretraining mixture.
records.audit_notes: No official conference or journal publication was found as of the verification date; retained as a preprint.

records.title: A Large-Scale Analysis on Contextual Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
records.method: Contextual VideoSSL Benchmark and Multi-Teacher Distillation
records.method_description: A controlled large-scale study benchmarks contextual video SSL factors and distills complementary representations from multiple pretrained teachers.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the CVPR 2025 TCV workshop publication.

records.title: Advancing video self-supervised learning via image foundation models
records.method_description: Frozen CLIP, MAE, or DINOv2 spatial features are paired with a lightweight ResNet3D temporal module trained through playback-rate perception.
records.dataset_notes: ImageNet-1K is the source pretraining benchmark for the frozen image foundation models; the video datasets support self-supervised adaptation and evaluation.

records.title: An Empirical Study of Autoregressive Pre-training from Videos
records.method_description: Causal autoregressive next-token prediction over discrete visual tokens using a decoder-only transformer trained on mixed image and video data.
records.dataset_notes: MVP denotes the simulated and real robot manipulation evaluations reported by the paper.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv catalog entry was promoted to its final ICCV 2025 publication.

records.title: ARVideo: Autoregressive Pretraining for Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: Autoregressive learning predicts clustered spatiotemporal visual tokens under randomized prediction orders rather than fixed raster order.
records.audit_notes: The 2024 arXiv paper was promoted to its TMLR 2025 publication.

records.title: AutoSSVH: Exploring Automated Frame Sampling for Efficient Self-Supervised Video Hashing
records.method_description: An adversarially optimized frame sampler, component voting, and point-to-set contrastive hashing learn efficient binary video retrieval codes.

records.title: Collaboratively Self-supervised Video Representation Learning for Action Recognition
records.method_description: Three collaborative branches learn future poses with a GAN, match current-future context, and generate current and future clips.
records.venue: IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security 2025
records.audit_notes: The 2024 arXiv record was promoted to the 2025 IEEE TIFS version of record.

records.title: CrossVideoMAE: Self-Supervised Image-Video Representation Learning with Masked Autoencoders
records.method_description: Cross-modal masked autoencoding aligns image and video representations using paired video clips and sampled still frames with shared and modality-specific objectives.
records.dataset_notes: Sampled frames from Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2 form the image side of joint pretraining; ImageNet-1K is used as an auxiliary image benchmark.
records.audit_notes: A personal-page reference to a medical workshop was not matched by official proceedings; the exact-title record remains a preprint.

records.title: Efficient Self-Supervised Video Hashing with Selective State Spaces
records.method_description: Selective state-space sequence modeling learns compact self-supervised video hashes while selecting informative temporal content efficiently.

records.title: Efficient VideoMAE via Temporal Progressive Training
records.method_description: A three-stage VideoMAE curriculum that progressively increases temporal coverage and masking difficulty while reusing learned weights.
records.dataset_notes: The curriculum is trained and evaluated separately on Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2.
records.audit_notes: The existing workshop label was retained and normalized to the official CVPR Workshops venue.

records.title: Entropy-Guided Masked Autoencoding for Self-Supervised Human Action Recognition Using Video Swin Transformer
records.method_description: Optical-flow motion entropy guides which Video Swin tubelets are masked and reconstructed during self-supervised action pretraining.

records.title: Exemplar-free class incremental action recognition based on self-supervised learning
records.method_description: A jointly self-supervised and supervised frozen feature extractor supports class increments using stored class statistics and pseudo-feature replay instead of video exemplars.

records.title: Feature Hallucination for Self-supervised Action Recognition
records.method_description: A multimodal translational framework hallucinates complementary optical-flow, object, skeleton, and audio features from RGB using modality-specific dense and semantic distillation.
records.dataset_notes: Kinetics-400, COCO/AVA, and Kinetics-Skeletons supply the pretrained auxiliary modality teachers used by the hallucination framework.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the 2025 IJCV version of record.

records.title: Hashtag2Action: Data Engineering and Self-Supervised Pre-Training for Action Recognition in Short-Form Videos
records.method_description: A hashtag-driven short-video collection and cleaning pipeline supplies domain-specific data for VideoMAE V2 self-supervised pretraining.
records.dataset_notes: Hashtag2Action contains 283,582 short-form clips in 386 action categories.

records.title: Intuitive physics understanding emerges from self-supervised pretraining on natural videos
records.method_description: Frozen V-JEPA representations are probed with violation-of-expectation tests and controlled ablations to study whether physical concepts emerge from natural-video pretraining.
records.dataset_notes: The three pretraining sources form the VideoMix2M mixture used by the evaluated V-JEPA model.
records.audit_notes: No later peer-reviewed exact-title publication was found as of the verification date.

records.title: Kdhiera: boosting self-supervised masked video modeling via hierarchical knowledge distillation
records.method_description: A hierarchical vision transformer combines high-ratio attention-guided masking with multi-layer feature distillation from off-the-shelf image and video teachers.

records.title: Label Ranker: Self-aware Preference for Classification Label Position in Visual Masked Self-supervised Pre-trained Model
records.method_description: Linear discriminant analysis and unsupervised clustering rank classification label positions for adapting masked image and video pretrained models.

records.title: Learning Complementary Knowledge via Trusted Multi-view Space Decomposition for Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning
records.method_description: Multi-view contrastive learning decomposes shared and private spaces, estimates view trustworthiness with a Dirichlet model, and preserves topology while encouraging compactness.
records.dataset_notes: The accessible publisher material explicitly exposes ImageNet and OGBG-MolBBBP results; the article is not limited to video benchmarks.

records.title: Learning from Streaming Video with Orthogonal Gradients
records.method_description: Streaming self-supervised optimization projects each gradient away from a compact basis of prior gradients to reduce catastrophic interference without replay.
records.dataset_notes: WalkingTours is the paper's Venice walking-tour stream; ImageNet-21K supplies the initialization used in future-prediction experiments.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the official CVPR 2025 publication.

records.title: Learning Video Representations without Natural Videos
records.method_description: VideoMAE is pretrained on progressively richer procedurally generated motion videos and crops of natural still images, without natural video pretraining.
records.dataset_notes: UCF101-P contains 14 out-of-distribution corruption sets.
records.audit_notes: The 2024 arXiv record was promoted to the ICCV 2025 LIMIT workshop publication.

records.title: Mitigating background bias in self-supervised video representation learning
records.method_description: Foreground motion is blended through frame-difference masks, and transformation-multiplier prediction plus spatial, temporal, and contrastive tasks discourages background shortcuts.
records.dataset_notes: The publisher abstract reports UCF101, HMDB51, and Diving48 under low-resource and full-compute settings.
records.audit_notes: The article was published online in December 2024 but is cited in volume 19 as a 2025 article; the catalog follows the publisher citation year.

records.title: MME: Video Representation Learning as World Model for Understanding and Planning
records.method_description: Masked representation learning reconstructs appearance together with dense long-term motion trajectories encoded from optical flow, position transitions, and trajectory-aligned HOG features.
records.dataset_notes: The accessible primary abstract describes a robot-arm manipulation task but does not name that benchmark.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title verification found only the TechRxiv record; a related earlier MME paper has a different title and was not treated as the final version.

records.title: Motion-driven Adaptive Frame Selection Strategy for Video Action Recognition
records.method_description: Motion-difference entropy and an adaptive selector retain frames with informative temporal change before action classification.
records.dataset_notes: The selector uses an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 backbone and is evaluated on three action-recognition datasets.
records.venue: EURASIP Journal on Image and Video Processing 2025
records.venue_normalized: EURASIP Journal on Image and Video Processing
records.audit_notes: The Research Square preprint link was replaced by the 2025 journal version of record.

records.title: OSKAR: Omnimodal Self-supervised Knowledge Abstraction and Representation
records.method_description: A fuse-then-predict joint-embedding architecture learns aligned video, skeleton, and text representations with modality-specific EMA targets and fixed token budgets.
records.dataset_notes: The paper samples 10 million OpenHumanVid3 videos and derives pseudo skeleton and caption modalities before downstream evaluation.
records.audit_notes: The NeurIPS capitalization and official proceedings link replace the earlier OpenReview PDF entry.

records.title: Privacy Preservation Using Superimposed 3D-Models for Self-Supervised Training in Action Recognition
records.method_description: A privacy-preserving pipeline combines MORTAL2MESH 3D overlays, K-NEXUS class sampling, and VideoMAE representation alignment.
records.dataset_notes: Kinetics-150 is curated from Kinetics-400; M2M-Kinetics is the privacy-preserving 3D-overlay version. VISPR denotes the paper's privacy evaluation subset.

records.title: Progressive self-supervised spatio-temporal feature learning based on video sequence saliency
records.method_description: Video sequence saliency scores order-prediction difficulty and creates a progressive curriculum for clip-order self-supervised spatiotemporal learning.
records.dataset_notes: The publisher abstract confirms clip/video retrieval and action-recognition experiments. UCF101, HMDB51, and Kinetics are the benchmark definitions present in the publisher metadata; the closed full text prevents a more granular split assignment.
records.audit_notes: The conference occurred in December 2024, while the citable SPIE proceedings version was published in March 2025; the catalog follows the version-of-record year.

records.title: Reinforcement Learning Meets Masked Video Modeling: Trajectory-Guided Adaptive Token Selection
records.method_description: A PPO-trained trajectory-aware sampler selects informative video tokens jointly with masked-autoencoder learning.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the ICCV 2025 Long Multi-Scene Video Foundations workshop publication.

records.title: Self-Supervised Learning of Motion Concepts by Optimizing Counterfactuals
records.method_description: A counterfactual world-model objective optimizes interventions on video inputs so latent prediction must encode object motion and physical correspondences.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to NeurIPS 2025 using the official conference listing and OpenReview record.

records.title: Self-supervised video representation learning based on foreground and temporal information.
records.method_description: A self-supervised branch combines foreground extraction with temporal-information prediction before transferring the encoder to action recognition.
records.dataset_notes: The proceedings metadata names UCF101, HMDB51, and an author-built dataset but does not expose a public name for the latter.

records.title: SF2T: Self-supervised Fragment Finetuning of Video-LLMs for Fine-Grained Understanding
records.method_description: Self-supervised fragment fine-tuning constructs hard temporal fragments and trains video-language models to distinguish fine-grained event ordering and boundaries.
records.dataset_notes: FineVidBench is assembled from Something-Something V2, Moments in Time, and Ego4D fragments.

records.title: SMILE: Infusing Spatial and Motion Semantics in Masked Video Learning
records.method_description: Masked video learning combines a CLIP spatial-semantic teacher with synthetic object-motion supervision to encode appearance and motion jointly.
records.dataset_notes: Places-80K and noise sources are used in synthetic-motion ablations. The long evaluation list includes the SEVERE robustness suite.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv entry was promoted to the official CVPR 2025 publication.

records.title: ST-HViT: spatial-temporal hierarchical vision transformer for action recognition
records.method_description: A two-stream spatial-temporal hierarchical vision transformer uses masked-autoencoder pretraining and a multi-scale convolutional decoder.
records.audit_notes: The DOI suffix contains 2024, but the publisher citation and volume assign the article to 2025.

records.title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning
records.method_description: A large joint-embedding predictive video model predicts masked latent representations; an action-conditioned post-training stage adapts it for planning and robot control.
records.dataset_notes: VideoMix22M combines the listed image and video sources; DROID is used for action-conditioned robot post-training rather than foundation pretraining.
records.audit_notes: No later peer-reviewed exact-title publication was found as of the verification date.

records.title: ViDROP: Video Dense Representation through Spatio-Temporal Sparsity
records.method_description: Dense video representation learning uses spatiotemporally sparse inputs and reconstruction objectives to retain local detail while exploiting pretrained video encoders.
records.audit_notes: The existing generic CVPR label was corrected to CVPR Workshops 2025.

records.title: When the Future Becomes the Past: Taming Temporal Correspondence for Self-supervised Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: Temporal correspondence regularization learns fine-grained pixel and region features by matching future and past observations without collapsing onto static shortcuts.

records.title: Asymmetric Masked Distillation for Pre-Training Small Foundation Models
records.method_description: A lightly masked teacher distills multi-layer representations to a more heavily masked small student through feature alignment and reconstruction.
records.dataset_notes: The paper reports an image AMD setting on ImageNet-1K and video AMD settings on Kinetics-400 and Something-Something V2.

records.title: Clustering-based multi-featured self-supervised learning for human activities and video retrieval
records.method_description: Loop-aware clustering fixes intra-class positive sampling and a second motion-feature stream supplies complementary action representations.
records.dataset_notes: The full-text evaluation figures identify UCF101 and HMDB51 action-recognition and retrieval benchmarks.

records.title: Controllable Augmentations for Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: Local and global views use soft region contrast, mutual-information minimization, and temporal-order dependency to align appearance and motion patterns.
records.audit_notes: The initial 2022 record was reconciled to the final proceedings or journal volume year.

records.title: CycleCL: Self-supervised Learning for Periodic Videos
records.method_description: Period-aware contrastive sampling uses temporal self-similarity matrices to form positive and negative pairs for repetitive-motion representations.

records.title: Data Collection-free Masked Video Modeling
records.method: Pseudo Motion Generator (PMG) with masked video modeling
records.method_description: PMG recursively transforms static images into pseudo-motion clips, enabling VideoMAE-style pretraining without collecting natural videos.
records.dataset_notes: PMG is evaluated with real and synthetic static-image sources; the downstream suite includes small, domain-shifted, and large-scale action datasets.

records.title: ES3: Evolving Self-Supervised Learning of Robust Audio-Visual Speech Representations
records.method_description: A three-stage evolving objective learns shared, modality-specific, and synergistic audio-visual speech representations.
records.dataset_notes: The primary configurations use 223 hours of LRS2-BBC and 433 hours of LRS3-TED; VoxCeleb2-En is discussed as an unavailable scale alternative.

records.title: EVEREST: Efficient Masked Video Autoencoder by Removing Redundant Spatiotemporal Tokens
records.method_description: Motion-rich frames and tokens are retained while redundant spatiotemporal tokens are removed during masked pretraining and fine-tuning.
records.audit_notes: The initial 2022 record was reconciled to the final proceedings or journal volume year.

records.title: Extending Video Masked Autoencoders to 128 Frames
records.method_description: A 128-frame masked autoencoder uses learned token importance and an adaptive decoder mask with quantized MAGVIT targets.
records.dataset_notes: The learned token selector uses Kinetics-600; some long-video training also incorporates unlabeled Kinetics-710 clips.

records.title: FILS: Self-Supervised Video Feature Prediction In Semantic Language Space
records.method_description: Patch-level video features are aligned with language semantics and predicted under masking using local video-text contrast and masked feature prediction.

records.title: GLOCAL: A self-supervised learning framework for global and local motion estimation
records.method_description: Global and local motion-estimation objectives use mixed-motion bottlenecks, reconstruction losses, and an attention U-Net to learn motion-sensitive features.

records.title: Learning to Predict Activity Progress by Self-Supervised Video Alignment
records.method_description: Multi-neighbor cycle-consistent alignment uses cycle-back regression, context-dependent dropout, and multi-head cross-task learning to predict activity progress.
records.dataset_notes: EgoProceL aggregates CMU-MMAC, EGTEA Gaze+, MECCANO, and EPIC-Tent procedure videos.

records.title: MAR: Masked Autoencoders for Efficient Action Recognition
records.method_description: Cell-running masks preserve alternating spatiotemporal evidence and a bridging classifier adapts reconstruction features for efficient action recognition.
records.audit_notes: The 2023 early-access article is assigned to IEEE TMM volume 26, pages 218-233, in 2024.

records.title: Motion-guided spatiotemporal multitask feature discrimination for self-supervised video representation learning
records.method_description: Static frames and frame differences decouple appearance and motion concepts, align their latent distributions, and guide discriminative local feature learning.

records.title: MotionMAE: Self-supervised Video Representation Learning with Motion-Aware Masked Autoencoders
records.method_description: Motion-aware masking selects dynamic regions for reconstruction and jointly models appearance and motion with spatial and temporal heads.
records.audit_notes: The initial 2022 record was reconciled to the final proceedings or journal volume year.

records.title: No More Shortcuts: Realizing the Potential of Temporal Self-Supervision
records.method: Out-of-order Frame Localization (OFL) and Time-varying Skiprate Prediction (TSP)
records.method_description: Frame-level temporal tasks and independent per-frame augmentation remove local appearance shortcuts while a temporal transformer extends contrastively pretrained frame features.
records.dataset_notes: UCF101 is used for core ablations; the main transferable representation is pretrained on Kinetics-400.

records.title: Positive and negative sampling strategies for self-supervised learning on audio-video data
records.method_description: Audio-visual correspondence learning replaces rigid instance positives with class-aware soft positives and evaluates alternative negative-sampling strategies.

records.title: Repeat and learn: Self-supervised visual representations learning by Repeated Scene Localization
records.method_description: A self-supervised localization pretext identifies repeated scenes and uses their temporal recurrence to learn action representations.
records.audit_notes: The previous CVPR venue label was incorrect; the title is a Pattern Recognition journal article.

records.title: Scaling 4D Representations
records.method_description: Masked-autoencoder video transformers are scaled from 20M to 22B parameters on up to 170M web videos for non-semantic 4D perception.
records.dataset_notes: The pretraining corpus is described by scale rather than released as a named public dataset.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record checks found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Self-supervised Learning of Semantic Correspondence Using Web Videos
records.method: Web-video correspondence mining with domain adaptation
records.method_description: Space-time correspondences mined from web videos are filtered with Isolation Forest and transferred to image correspondence through unsupervised domain adaptation.
records.dataset_notes: The web videos are retrieved using object classes represented in the three target correspondence benchmarks.

records.title: Self-supervised learning of video representations from a child's perspective
records.method_description: Video masked autoencoders learn from longitudinal SAYCam head-camera footage and are compared with duration-matched and full Kinetics pretraining.
records.dataset_notes: OOD ImageNet denotes the 17 perturbation and transformation tasks used by the paper.
records.audit_notes: The main catalog link now points to the official proceedings or publisher record; the arXiv version remains in verification metadata.

records.title: Self-Supervised Learning via Multi-Transformation Classification for Action Recognition
records.method_description: A 3D CNN predicts the original state or seven spatial, temporal, and signal transformations applied to video clips.
records.audit_notes: The catalog's prior NeurIPS PDF URL pointed to a different paper and was replaced with the correct manuscript and ICMEW DOI. The main catalog link now points to the official proceedings or publisher record; the arXiv version remains in verification metadata.

records.title: Self-supervised Video Object Segmentation with Distillation Learning of Deformable Attention
records.method_description: A lightweight deformable-attention memory adapts key and value locations across frames and is trained through attention-map knowledge distillation.
records.audit_notes: The arXiv record still states under review and no version of record was found through the verification date.

records.title: Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning by Video Incoherence Detection
records.method_description: Hierarchically sampled subclips create incoherence whose location and duration are predicted, with intra-video contrastive regularization.
records.audit_notes: The 2023 early-access article is assigned to volume 54, issue 6, pages 3810-3822, in 2024.

records.title: Self-supervised Video Representation Learning via Capturing Semantic Changes Indicated by Saccades
records.method_description: Bio-inspired saccades locate semantic changes for contrastive learning, with fixation consistency and prototypical reorganization objectives.
records.venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology 2024
records.audit_notes: The 2023 early-access record belongs to volume 34, issue 8, published in 2024; the final issue year is used.

records.title: SIGMA: Sinkhorn-Guided Masked Video Modeling
records.method_description: Sinkhorn optimal transport assigns masked video features to learnable prototypes, producing balanced high-entropy semantic reconstruction targets.
records.dataset_notes: The SEVERE suite contributes Gym99, UCF101 and FineGym low-shot tests, FX-S1, UB-S1, UCFRep, and Charades.

records.title: ST2ST: Self-Supervised Test-time Adaptation for Video Action Recognition
records.method_description: Test-time adaptation enforces self-supervised consistency between frames and aggregated super-frames while updating a pretrained action recognizer.

records.title: Structured Video-Language Modeling with Temporal Grouping and Spatial Grounding
records.method_description: Inter-clip spatial grounding aligns learned region groups with nouns, while intra-clip temporal grouping detects cut-and-paste scene changes.
records.audit_notes: The 2023 arXiv title changed before publication; the final ICLR 2024 title and venue are now used, with the former title retained in previous_titles.

records.title: Text-Guided Video Masked Autoencoder
records.method_description: Caption-video correspondence selects semantically salient regions for masking, combined with MAE reconstruction and masked video-text contrastive learning.

records.title: Towards Latent Masked Image Modeling for Self-supervised Visual Representation Learning
records.method_description: Joint online and target masked-image modeling is stabilized in latent space by addressing collapse, correlated targets, objectives, and decoder conditioning.

records.title: ViC-MAE: Self-supervised Representation Learning from Images and Video with Contrastive Masked Autoencoders
records.method_description: Masked reconstruction is combined with contrastive learning over globally pooled local features across images and video frames.

records.title: VicTR: Video-conditioned Text Representations for Activity Recognition
records.method_description: Video-conditioned text embeddings and visually grounded auxiliary semantics create a flexible contrastive space for activity recognition.

records.method_description: Cross-modal contrastive learning removes highly related false negatives using intra-modal similarity and aligns local and global embeddings.

records.title: Enhancing self-supervised video representation learning via multi-level feature optimization
records.method_description: Low-, mid-, and high-level feature objectives combine local contrast, temporal modeling, and global instance discrimination.

records.title: Enhancing unsupervised video representation learning by decoupling the scene and the motion
records.method_description: Spatial and temporal local disturbances form scene-broken and motion-broken views that explicitly separate appearance from motion.

records.title: Inter-intra Variant Dual Representations for Self-supervised Video Recognition
records.method_description: Dual heads encode variation between videos and complementary variation among clips from the same video.

records.title: Learning temporal dynamics from cycles in narrated video
records.method_description: Vision and language dynamics predict forward and backward in time and are constrained to form invertible temporal cycles.

records.title: Long short view feature decomposition via contrastive video representation learning
records.method_description: Long and short views decompose stationary video attributes from non-stationary temporal attributes.

records.title: MoDist: Motion Distillation for Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: An optical-flow teacher distills motion-sensitive targets into an RGB video encoder without flow at inference.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Motion-augmented self-training for video recognition at smaller scale
records.method_description: A small labeled optical-flow teacher pseudo-labels a large unlabeled collection, then an RGB student learns with a multi-clip loss.
records.dataset_notes: Kinetics-400 supplies unlabeled self-training video; the small target datasets train the motion teacher and evaluate transfer.

records.title: Motion-focused contrastive learning of video representations
records.method_description: Optical flow guides tubelet sampling and aligns convolutional gradient maps with spatial and temporal motion patterns.

records.title: On compositions of transformations in contrastive self-supervised learning
records.method_description: A generalized transformation framework specifies which spatial, temporal, audio, and text transformations should be invariant or distinctive.

records.title: Parameter Efficient Multimodal Transformers for Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: Modality-specific and shared low-rank Transformers learn masked embedding prediction and cross-modal pair prediction with content-aware negatives.
records.audit_notes: The initial 2020 preprint record was reconciled to the accepted archival conference version.

records.title: Removing the background by adding the background: Towards background robust self-supervised video representation learning
records.method_description: A static frame is added to every frame of a clip and the original and distracted clips are aligned to suppress background dependence.

records.title: RSPNet: Relative Speed Perception for Unsupervised Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: Relative playback-speed prediction is paired with an appearance-focused task to retain motion and appearance cues.

records.title: SeCo: Exploring Sequence Supervision for Unsupervised Representation Learning
records.method_description: Frame, clip, and sequence-level contrastive tasks model spatial identity, video identity, and temporal order.

records.title: Self-supervised learning of compressed video representations
records.method_description: I-frames, motion vectors, and residuals provide complementary self-supervision directly in the compressed-video domain.

records.title: Self-supervised video representation learning by context and motion decoupling
records.method_description: Compressed-video keyframes supervise context matching and motion vectors supervise future-motion prediction.

records.title: Self-supervised video representation learning with meta-contrastive network
records.method_description: A meta-learning loop adapts the contrastive objective to generate more transferable video representations.

records.title: Self-supervised visual learning by variable playback speeds prediction of a video
records.method_description: The model predicts randomized forward, reverse, and mixed playback speeds with temporal group normalization.

records.title: Spatiotemporal contrastive video representation learning
records.method_description: Two temporally separated clips receive temporally consistent spatial augmentation and are contrasted as views of one video.

records.title: Temporally coherent embeddings for self-supervised video representation learning
records.method_description: A temporal-coherence metric loss keeps nearby frames close and temporally separated frames distinct in embedding space.
records.dataset_notes: The conference retained the ICPR 2020 name but the IEEE proceedings record was published in 2021.

records.title: Time-equivariant contrastive video representation learning
records.method_description: Representations are trained to transform predictably under temporal shifts while remaining invariant to content-preserving appearance changes.

records.title: Unsupervised video representation learning by bidirectional feature prediction
records.method_description: Past and future latent features are predicted jointly, with swapped temporal predictions forming hard negatives.

records.title: Unsupervised visual representation learning by tracking patches in video
records.method_description: Synthetic moving patches create a tracking game in which a 3D encoder predicts each patch trajectory and scale.

records.title: VATT: Transformers for multimodal self-supervised learning from raw video, audio and text
records.method_description: Video, audio, and text transformers are trained end-to-end from raw signals with multimodal contrastive alignment.

records.title: Vi2CLR: Video and image for visual contrastive learning of representation
records.method_description: Image and video batches share a contrastive encoder, transferring spatial appearance supervision into spatiotemporal learning.

records.title: Video contrastive learning with global context
records.method_description: Segment-level positives capture global video context and temporal-order regularization preserves long-range sequence structure.

records.title: VideoMoCo: Contrastive Video Representation Learning with Temporally Adversarial Examples
records.method_description: An adversarial frame-drop generator creates temporally robust views and temporal decay reweights stale keys in the memory queue.

records.title: VIMPAC: Video Pre-Training via Masked Token Prediction and Contrastive Learning
records.method_description: Blockwise masked prediction over VQ-VAE video tokens is combined with augmentation-free same-video contrastive learning.

records.title: Watching the World Go By: Representation Learning from Unlabeled Videos
records.method_description: Multi-frame, multi-positive noise-contrastive learning uses temporally related natural video views and a momentum memory bank.
records.dataset_notes: R2V2 is the authors' Random Related Video Views collection; URL-based YouTube-8M and Kinetics-400 collections are reported as variants.
records.audit_notes: The initial 2020 preprint record was reconciled to the accepted archival conference version.

records.title: Watching too much television is good: Self-supervised audio-visual representation learning from movies and tv shows
records.method_description: Audio-visual contrastive learning exploits long-form movies and television, including recurring characters, scenes, and sounds.
records.dataset_notes: The training collection is described by media type rather than released as a named benchmark.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: AudioVisual SlowFast Networks for Video Recognition
records.method_description: Slow and Fast visual pathways are joined by a faster audio pathway with hierarchical fusion, DropPathway, and audio-video synchronization supervision.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Can temporal information help with contrastive self-supervised learning?
records.method_description: Temporal transformations augment contrastive positives and also define auxiliary rotation, reversal, shuffling, and speed-prediction tasks.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Contrastive multiview coding
records.method_description: A view-agnostic contrastive objective maximizes shared information across sensory views, including video RGB frames and optical flow.

records.title: Cycle-Contrast for Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: Cycle consistency aligns frame and video embeddings, while contrastive discrimination and a diversity regularizer prevent degenerate correspondences.

records.title: End-to-end learning of visual representations from uncurated instructional videos
records.method_description: Multiple-instance video-text contrastive learning treats nearby narrations as candidate positives to tolerate temporal misalignment.

records.title: Evolving losses for unsupervised video representation learning
records.method_description: Evolutionary search composes ordering, reconstruction, cross-modal alignment, and contrastive losses using an unsupervised distribution-matching fitness score.
records.dataset_notes: Pretraining uses a random two-million-video subset sampled from YouTube-8M.

records.title: Look, Listen, and Attend: Co-Attention Network for Self-Supervised Audio-Visual Representation Learning
records.method_description: Visual-guided, audio-guided, and cross-modal co-attention learn audio-video correspondence and synchronization.
records.dataset_notes: AudioSet-240K is resegmented without constraining the clips to the original label ontology.

records.title: Memory-augmented dense predictive coding for video representation learning
records.method_description: Predictive attention over a compressed memory bank constructs multiple hypotheses for future latent states in RGB or optical flow.
records.dataset_notes: Oops is used for additional self-supervised adaptation and downstream evaluation in the failure-recognition experiment.

records.title: Pretext-Contrastive Learning: Toward Good Practices in Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: Contrastive learning is jointly optimized with video cloze, clip-order, or rotation pretext branches using residual clips and strong augmentation.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Self-supervised co-training for video representation learning
records.method_description: RGB and optical-flow encoders alternate training, using one view to mine hard semantic positives for the other.

records.title: Self-supervised learning by cross-modal audio-video clustering
records.method_description: Audio and video are alternately clustered, and cluster assignments from one modality supervise the representation of the other.
records.dataset_notes: The paper reports AudioSet-240K and Instagram variants, including random and Kinetics-filtered Instagram subsets.

records.title: Self-supervised learning of audio-visual objects from video
records.method_description: Attention localizes discrete sound sources, optical flow aggregates and tracks them, and synchronization plus mix-and-separate provide supervision.
records.dataset_notes: The Simpsons and Sesame Street footage are private or program-specific collections rather than released benchmarks.

records.title: Self-Supervised Learning to Detect Key Frames in Videos
records.method_description: LDA-derived pseudo-labels supervise a two-stream RGB and optical-flow ConvNet initialized from ImageNet VGG-16 features.
records.dataset_notes: ImageNet-1K is supervised VGG-16 initialization; UCF101 supplies the unlabeled key-frame training videos.

records.title: Self-supervised motion representation via scattering local motion cues
records.method_description: A coarse-to-fine network scatters local motion regions and uses context-guided semantic upsampling to learn explicit motion maps.

records.title: Self-supervised multimodal versatile networks
records.method_description: Fine-and-coarse video, audio, and text contrastive learning produces one representation transferable across modalities and tasks.

records.title: Self-supervised temporal discriminative learning for video representation learning
records.method_description: Temporally consistent augmentations form metric-learning triplets that distinguish clips within a video and across videos.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Self-supervised video representation learning by maximizing mutual information
records.method_description: Clip-level mutual information links clips from one video, while motion-level mutual information links clip features to salient local motion regions.

records.title: Self-supervised video representation learning by pace prediction
records.method_description: Playback pace classification is coupled with a same-content contrastive objective to learn motion-sensitive representations.

records.title: Self-supervised video representation learning using inter-intra contrastive framework
records.method_description: RGB, residual, and optical-flow views provide positives, while other videos and shuffled or repeated clips provide inter- and intra-video negatives.

records.title: Speech2Action: Cross-Modal Supervision for Action Recognition
records.method_description: BERT learns speech-to-action correlations from screenplays, mines weak action labels in movies, and supervises an S3D-G action model.
records.dataset_notes: The mined pretraining collection contains clips drawn from a large private movie and speech corpus; IMSDb provides screenplay text for the speech-action model.

records.title: SpeedNet: Learning the Speediness in Videos
records.method_description: A dynamic-frame network predicts whether a clip plays at its natural rate or has been artificially sped up.

records.title: UniVL: A Unified Video and Language Pre-Training Model for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
records.method_description: Unimodal encoders, a cross encoder, and a decoder learn five video-language alignment, masking, and reconstruction objectives in staged training.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Unsupervised learning from video with deep neural embeddings
records.method_description: Video instance recognition and local aggregation learn persistent embeddings with single-stream, 3D, SlowFast, and two-pathway variants.

records.title: Unsupervised learning of video representations via dense trajectory clustering
records.method_description: Video instance recognition and local aggregation use improved-dense-trajectory Fisher vectors to seed motion-aware clusters.
records.dataset_notes: The workshop proceedings appeared online in 2021, but the archival event is ECCV Workshops 2020.

records.title: Video cloze procedure for self-supervised spatio-temporal learning
records.method_description: Spatial and temporal cloze transformations create missing clips, and the network classifies the operation needed to complete them.

records.title: Video playback rate perception for self-supervised spatio-temporal representation learning
records.method_description: Dilated sampling-rate classification is combined with reconstructive decoding and motion attention in a discriminative-generative objective.

records.title: Video representation learning by recognizing temporal transformations
records.method_description: The encoder classifies speed changes, random skips, periodic frame warps, and forward or backward playback.

records.title: Video representation learning with visual tempo consistency
records.method_description: Slow and fast clips form tempo views whose shared information is contrasted hierarchically across network stages.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: DynamoNet: Dynamic Action and Motion Network
records.method_description: Dynamic motion filters predict short-term future frames while a shared 3D CNN jointly learns action classification.
records.dataset_notes: The future-prediction branch is self-supervised, but the joint action-classification branch uses labels; training and evaluation are reported dataset-wise.

records.title: Learning Video Representations Using Contrastive Bidirectional Transformer
records.method_description: A bidirectional Transformer replaces masked-token softmax with noise-contrastive estimation and optionally aligns video with ASR text.
records.dataset_notes: Kinetics-600 supports short-term visual pretraining; HowTo100M and its ASR support long-term and cross-modal pretraining. The temporal branch also uses a supervised Kinetics S3D feature extractor and a frozen text BERT checkpoint.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Self-supervised spatio-temporal representation learning for videos by predicting motion and appearance statistics
records.method_description: A C3D encoder regresses local and global motion-boundary locations, directions, and spatiotemporal color statistics.
records.dataset_notes: UCF101 is the default self-supervised pretraining set; the paper also reports a Kinetics-400 pretraining variant.

records.title: Self-supervised spatiotemporal learning via video clip order prediction
records.method_description: A siamese 3D ConvNet encodes clips and predicts the permutation of their pairwise-concatenated features.

records.title: Self-supervised video representation learning with space-time cubic puzzles
records.method_description: A four-tower 3D ResNet rearranges permuted spatial or temporal video cubes while jittering and channel replication block trivial cues.

records.title: Temporal Cycle-Consistency Learning
records.method_description: Soft nearest-neighbor cycle-back classification or regression aligns frames across different videos of the same process.
records.dataset_notes: The paper reports both training from scratch and self-supervised fine-tuning from an ImageNet-1K supervised ResNet-50 initialization.

records.title: Video Jigsaw: Unsupervised Learning of Spatiotemporal Context for Video Action Recognition
records.method_description: Spatial patches sampled across several frames are permuted, and a shared CNN predicts the spatiotemporal jigsaw arrangement.
records.dataset_notes: The main transferable model is pretrained on Kinetics-400; UCF101 is also used in pretraining ablations.

records.title: Video representation learning by dense predictive coding
records.method_description: A recurrent context model predicts dense latent feature maps for future spatiotemporal blocks using contrastive predictive coding.

records.title: VideoBERT: A Joint Model for Video and Language Representation Learning
records.method_description: BERT jointly models masked sequences of vector-quantized visual tokens and ASR word tokens with a visual-language alignment objective.
records.dataset_notes: The 312K-video cooking corpus is a private YouTube collection. Kinetics-400 initializes S3D; BooksCorpus and English Wikipedia initialize the released BERT-Large text checkpoint.

records.title: Audio-Visual Scene Analysis with Self-Supervised Multisensory Features
records.method_description: A fused 3D visual and raw-waveform audio network predicts whether sound and video are temporally aligned, producing features used for localization, action recognition, and source separation.
records.dataset_notes: The core multisensory representation is learned from about 750,000 AudioSet videos. VoxCeleb and VoxCeleb2 are used for task-specific source-separation training and GRID for transfer evaluation.

records.title: Compressed Video Action Recognition
records.method_description: Separate CNN streams process I-frames, motion vectors, and residuals directly from compressed video, and recurrent aggregation combines their predictions over time.
records.dataset_notes: This is a supervised action-recognition paper rather than a self-supervised pretraining method. Its component CNNs use supervised ImageNet-1K initialization.

records.title: Cooperative Learning of Audio and Video Models from Self-Supervised Synchronization
records.method_description: Two-stream audio and video encoders learn temporal synchronization with a contrastive objective and a curriculum that progresses from easy to hard negative pairs.
records.dataset_notes: The paper trains separate AVTS models on Kinetics-400, AudioSet, and the SoundNet collection; downstream experiments cover both visual and audio recognition.

records.title: Geometry Guided Convolutional Neural Networks for Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning
records.method_description: A progressive geometry curriculum first predicts optical flow from synthetic image pairs and then predicts stereo disparity from real 3D movies while distillation preserves the learned motion representation.
records.dataset_notes: Web 3D Movies denotes the authors' private collection of approximately 80 stereoscopic films and 40,000 frame pairs.

records.title: Improving Spatiotemporal Self-Supervision by Deep Reinforcement Learning
records.method_description: A REINFORCE policy adaptively samples useful spatial and temporal ordering permutations while a shared network learns to solve both tasks.
records.dataset_notes: ImageNet-1K supplies images for the spatial ordering task, while UCF101 supplies video frames for the temporal ordering task.

records.title: Learning and Using the Arrow of Time
records.method: Temporal Class Activation Map Network (T-CAM) / Arrow of Time
records.method_description: A long-range forward-versus-reversed video classifier learns temporal features, with class activation maps and preprocessing used to localize evidence and suppress codec, camera, and editing shortcuts.
records.dataset_notes: Flickr-AoT and Kinetics-AoT are constructed for arrow-of-time training and testing; TA180 and ReverseFilm are targeted temporal-asymmetry evaluation sets.

records.title: Self-Supervised Spatiotemporal Feature Learning via Video Rotation Prediction
records.method_description: A 3D ConvNet predicts one of four in-plane rotations applied consistently to every frame of a clip, encouraging joint spatial and temporal understanding.
records.audit_notes: Exact-title and author-record searches found no peer-reviewed version through the verification date.

records.title: Self-Supervised Video Representation Learning With Odd-One-Out Networks
records.method_description: A multi-branch CNN receives several temporally ordered subsequences and one frame-shuffled subsequence from the same video, then learns to identify the odd input through shared encoders and feature fusion.
records.dataset_notes: Self-supervised feature learning and downstream action classification are reported on UCF101 and HMDB51 without external pretrained weights or optical-flow inputs.

records.title: Unsupervised Representation Learning by Sorting Sequences
records.method_description: A Siamese CNN extracts features from every pair in a shuffled frame tuple and predicts its chronological permutation, using motion-aware sampling, spatial jittering, and channel splitting to suppress shortcuts.
records.dataset_notes: The main model is self-supervised on UCF101 and transferred to UCF101, HMDB51, and PASCAL VOC 2007. The paper also reports dataset-specific unsupervised pretraining on HMDB51.

records.title: Shuffle and Learn: Unsupervised Learning Using Temporal Order Verification
records.method: Shuffle and Learn / Temporal Order Verification
records.method_description: A triplet Siamese CNN learns from high-motion frame tuples by classifying whether the middle frame makes the sequence temporally valid, treating both forward and reverse chronology as valid.
records.dataset_notes: The self-supervised model is pretrained on unlabeled UCF101 training videos, then evaluated on action recognition and human pose estimation. A separate experiment combines it with supervised ImageNet-1K initialization.
